fact: Decree 2018-1270 (art. 6) says electronic communications providers have access to the Office National d'Identification database, on terms to be set by order of the Security Minister, for subscriber identification; it states no check in operation.

Cybastion says it is leading implementation of electronic signature through Burkina Faso's public key infrastructure, with the platform installed and about thirty people, including ANSSI staff, trained on it on 28-30 April 2025.

Digital Magazine reports that ANSSI, with US firm Cybastion, opened a scoping workshop on 30 September 2024 for a national public key infrastructure with root and issuing certification authorities and remote electronic signature, implementation set for December 2025.
The Prime Minister launched the FasoSign national e-signature platform on 15 September 2026; ANSSI's director general says it provides formal authentication of the signer and is already operational.
ANSSI's director general says FasoSign is already operational on three government systems: SIGED (official correspondence), CIMEXT (mission orders) and SYC@D (land cession orders).
